entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary:
This film introduces Made With Care, New Zealand’s food and beverage story, designed to help exporters and partners show up with confidence in international markets. 

The film brings together New Zealand’s defining values, our deep connection to land and sea. These elements create a clear, consistent story that reflects what sets New Zealand food and beverage apart globally: premium quality, trust, and integrity. 

This film is part of a broader suite of refreshed resources including messaging and imagery, created to support use across trade shows, market activations, and digital campaigns. 

Explore the full Made With Care toolkit: https://toolkit.nzstory.govt.nz/assets?tag=Food+and+Beverage+Story&order=released
